name: Heroes of Book & Paper
detailed_description:
Description

HB&P is an old-school RPG game that uses an 80s/90s style of design and concept. Your decisions will determine the ending of each adventure you take. Every story has different and random components, what it means that the stories will vary from game to game.

Even though HB&P is an 80s/90s style game, we have taken the liberty of saving you from having to read the boring endless story paragraphs.

The Game

Here is how we begin. You, the player, will generate a character from a series of available classes which enters a medieval fantasy world. There are 8 classes to choose from: Warrior, Wizard, Rogue, Bard, Necromancer, Priest, Hunter and Assassin.

This world is made up of stories, and these stories are completely replayable since they are based on the player's decisions, their character, their skills and items. To add to this, all the stories have a procedural component that generates new options, places, encounters, characters, traps, combats, or random loot, even if you replay the same story with the same character! Some stories may also change their storyline each time you play them again, and making different choices and decisions will lead you to other endings in each game.

Two game modes

HB&P includes two game modes: Unlimited Free play and Campaign.

- In the Unlimited Free play, the adventures can be completed in the order you chose, and these can be played as many times as you like. You can choose from 6 difficulty modes and adjust each adventure to your liking. Even if your character dies, he/she will keep all the equipment and loot obtained, and can continue in a new adventure, or repeat the same one.

-In campaign mode you will have to overcome 5 randomly generated stories in the given order with increasing difficulty. If your character dies during the campaign, your adventure will be terminated!.

Progression

Characters will gain experience points and will be able to level up, so in the next adventure they will be more powerful. There is no level limit, and you can level up your character's stats as much as you want.

Features

- 8 classes of characters to choose from, each with their own play style and equipment.
- 12 stories that are fully replayable.
- More than 300 game pages, and these pages can change every time you play!.
- Two game modes: Unlimited Free Mode and Campaign Mode.
- More than 350 images of places of adventure,
- 180 items including weapons, spells and accessories.
- Over 100 monsters to defeat.
- More than 100 different sounds.
- Epic soundtracks.

Thanks

HEROES OF BOOK & PAPER is a game for those who once enjoyed reading gamebooks and still let their imagination run wild.

Thank you for reading - HEROES OF BOOK & PAPER -
